label: Kuala Terengganu terrace house storm

sequence: Thunderstorm with heavy rain from 6:45 pm on 21 May 2024, maximum gust 48 km/h
The rear box gutter, blocked with leaves and silt, overflows
Rainwater runs back under the bottom row of tiles into the roof space above the rear bedroom and corridor
Further water is driven in through deteriorated sealant around the rear bedroom window frame
All roof tiles in place; nothing displaced or broken by the wind

gates.name: Period of insurance
gates.reason: Loss on 21 May 2024 falls inside 1 October 2023 to 30 September 2024.

gates.name: Peril insured
gates.reason: Proximate cause: storm rain in a thunderstorm, entering through a blocked gutter and window frame gaps, with no intervening event. Storm damage is excluded under Condition 6 but brought in by FP503.

gates.name: Conditions precedent
gates.reason: Notice on 22 May 2024; written claim delivered 28 May 2024, day 7 of 15.

gates.name: Endorsement held
gates.reason: FP503 is on the schedule and overrides Condition 6(b).

gates.name: Endorsement satisfied
gates.reason: FP503 Special Condition 1 not met: the building did not first sustain damage to its roof or walls by the direct force of the wind. Rain entered through a blocked gutter and window frame gaps, not through openings made by the storm.

gates.name: Item admitted
gates.reason: Not asked: the claim stopped at an earlier gate.

quotes.text: 1. The Company shall not be liable for any loss or damage caused by water or rain, whether driven by wind or not unless the building insured or containing the property insured shall first sustain actual damage to the roof or walls of same by the direct force of Hurricane, Cyclone, Typhoon and Windstorm and shall then be liable only for such damage to the interior of the building or the insured property therein as may be caused by water or rain entering the building through openings in the roof or walls made by the direct force of the said perils.

notwithstanding anything stated to the contrary in Condition No. 6 of the Policy, this insurance extends to cover loss or damage directly caused by fire or otherwise occasioned by or through or in consequence of Hurricane, Cyclone, Typhoon and Windstorm,

during the Period of Insurance stated in the Schedule or of any subsequent period in respect of which the Insured shall have paid and the Company shall have accepted the premium required for the renewal of this Policy

must_not_cite.reason: Not held, and the water was rain entering through the roof edge and a window, not a flow or accumulation of water from outside the building.
The Insured's belief about the tiles is a mistaken account, not a misrepresentation at proposal. The decision rests on the verified cause.
No fraud. The Insured honestly attributed the damage to the wind; the adjuster's finding corrects the cause, it does not show a false declaration.

working: Declined at gate 5. Counterfactual only: 6,300.00 + 2,400.00 + 4,200.00 + 1,500.00 = 14,400.00, less FP503 excess 200.00 = 14,200.00, not payable.
